summary: Moshe Hachim discusses the significance of the phrase Na'aseh Nishma, which Bnei Yisrael declared at Har Sinai. He explores how this commitment to act before understanding serves as a model for living a Jewish life and finding purpose. The class also addresses the difficulty of maintaining this commitment during challenging times.
questions: Why did Bnei Yisrael say Na'aseh Nishma?
How does performing a misva lead to understanding?
Is it necessary to understand a commitment before making it?
How should one handle moments when faith feels difficult?
